design_intent.original_text: Make it a 3x3x3 cube with no gravity: players still alternate placing X and O in any empty cell; any straight line of three cells through the cube (rows, columns, pillars and every diagonal, 49 lines in total) wins; a full cube with no line is a draw.
preserve: Players alternate turns placing X and O.
changes: Remove gravity; a player may place their mark in any empty cell.
Award a win for any straight line of three cells through the cube, including rows, columns, pillars, and every diagonal: 49 winning lines in total.
Declare a draw when the cube is full and neither player has a winning line.
constraints: Marks may be placed only in empty cells.

lift_plan.neighborhood: Winning lines use straight, contiguous triples along the three axes and all face and body diagonals: 27 axial lines, 18 face diagonals, and 4 body diagonals, for 49 lines total.
lift_plan.movement: On a turn, place the current player's mark in any empty (x,y,z) cell. Reject occupied or out-of-bounds targets without changing state. Do not allow placements after a win or draw. Restart resets all 27 cells and the turn; quit retains its Source behavior.
lift_plan.outcomes: After each legal placement, a line of three matching marks anywhere in the cube wins for its owner. Check wins before declaring a draw; a draw requires every cube cell occupied and no winning line.
lift_plan.presentation: Show the board as one continuous cube volume using the engine-owned cell shells, 3D positions, colliders, and overview camera. Display X and O in their occupied cells and retain turn, winner, and draw status.

source_game_spec.summary: Two players alternate placing X and O on a 3×3 grid; three in a row wins, and a full board without a win is a draw.

initial_setup.description: Every cell is empty; X moves first, with no winner or draw.

actions.effect: Stop the application loop; no game outcome is assigned.
